diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references

aws_autoscaling_group.ng explicitly lists aws_launch_template.ng in depends_on, but the dependency is already established implicitly: the ASG's mixed_instances_policy references aws_launch_template.ng[each.key].id (and latest_version). The explicit depends_on entry duplicates that attribute reference and can be removed.

aws_eks_node_group.ng explicitly lists aws_iam_role.ng in depends_on, but node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.ng.0.arn already creates that dependency implicitly. The explicit depends_on entry on aws_iam_role.ng is redundant (the policy-attachment entries remain meaningful, since those are not otherwise referenced).
